definition_zh: 条；棒；酒吧；栏杆；障碍；禁止；把……闩住
definition_en: a long rigid piece of material; a place serving drinks; a barrier; to forbid or fasten
core_image: 一根横着的铁条：能当杠杆，能拦住门，也能拦住人
scene: 铁匠铺里炉火通明，学徒递上铁条。The blacksmith bent the bar into a gate latch.
sceneCN: 这里 bar 指「铁条」（第 1 个义项：长条硬材）；句意：铁匠把铁条弯成门闩。

derivatives.zh: 障碍物；屏障（与 bar 同族，经法语）
路障（同族，经西班牙/意大利语）

senses.title: A long rigid piece
senses.definition: a long straight piece of metal, wood, or other solid material
senses.definitionCN: 金属、木材等的长条形硬料
senses.example: He bought a bar of chocolate and a bar of iron.
senses.exampleCN: 他买了一块巧克力和一根铁条。
senses.why: The root meant a rod or bough; the shape defines the word.
senses.whyCN: 词根本指树枝或杆条；形状定义了这个词。

senses.title: A fastening rod across a door
senses.definition: a rod used to bolt a door shut
senses.definitionCN: 横插门上使门紧闭的杆
senses.example: She slid the bar across the gate.
senses.why: A rod laid across an opening blocks it.
senses.whyCN: 横放在开口上的杆便构成阻挡。

senses.title: A barrier or obstruction
senses.definition: something that blocks passage or progress
senses.why: The gate-bar widened into any blocker.
senses.whyCN: 门闩之杆扩大为一切阻碍。

senses.title: The law courts railing
senses.definition: the railing separating court officials from the public, hence the legal profession
senses.definitionCN: 隔开法官与旁听席的栏杆，转指司法界
senses.example: She was called to the bar last year.
senses.why: The physical bar in court named the profession behind it.
senses.whyCN: 法庭里那道栏杆命名了栏杆后的职业。

senses.title: The counter or shop serving drinks
senses.definition: a counter or establishment where drinks are served
senses.definitionCN: 供应饮品的柜台或场所
senses.example: They met at the hotel bar.
senses.why: Drinks were handed over a barred counter.
senses.whyCN: 饮品隔着带栅栏的柜台递出。

senses.title: To forbid or exclude
senses.definition: to prevent someone from entering or doing something
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某人进入或做某事
senses.example: Visitors are barred from the lab.
senses.why: To bar a door is to bar the person behind it.
senses.whyCN: 闩住了门，也就挡住了门后的人。

senses.title: To fasten with a bar
senses.definition: to secure a door or window with a bar
senses.example: He barred the shutters before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨来之前他闩紧了百叶窗。
senses.why: The literal rod returns as a physical act.
senses.whyCN: 实体的杆还原为物理动作。

senses.title: Except (barring)
senses.example: Barring accidents, we arrive by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 只要不出意外，中午前到达。
senses.why: Barring means shutting out the exceptions.
senses.whyCN: barring 即把例外「挡在外面」。

intro.en: Bar comes from Old French barre, a rod or beam, probably from a Gallo-Romance form related to Late Latin barra; the same line gives barrier, barricade, and embargo.
intro.cn: bar 出自古法语 barre「杆、梁」，或与后期拉丁语 barra 相关；barrier、barricade、embargo 均属同一词线。

items.en: barra named a rod or bar, of uncertain earlier origin.
items.cn: 后期拉丁语 barra 指杆条，更早来源不确定。

items.en: barre meant a beam, bar, or gate-bar.
items.cn: 古法语 barre 指梁、杆、门闩。

items.en: Law French carried barre into English courts as the railing of justice.
items.cn: 法律法语把 barre 带入英国法庭，成为司法围栏。

items.en: English reduced the form to bar and multiplied the senses.
items.cn: 英语把词形缩为 bar，义项随之繁衍。

items.en: The tavern counter and the verb of exclusion grew in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.
items.cn: 酒馆柜台义与禁止动词兴于十六、十七世纪。

items.en: The word now spans hardware, law, trade, and the drink counter.
items.cn: 现代该词横跨五金、法律、贸易与酒柜。

note.en: Group one holds the rod family and look-alikes; group two holds the blocking field.
note.cn: 第一组收「杆条」词族与形近词；第二组收「阻挡」义场。

entries.definition: a fence or obstacle; bar plus a French suffix.
a court lawyer; one called to the bar.
entries.definitionCN: 出庭律师；被准入法庭围栏内者。

entries.definition: uncovered; from Old English bær, no kin to bar.
entries.definitionCN: 赤裸的；出古英语 bær，与 bar 词源无关。

entries.definition: something that stands in the way.

normalIntro.en: bar is one syllable of hard matter: the same rod bolts doors, divides courts, and serves drinks.
normalIntro.cn: bar 是一个音节的硬物：同一根杆，闩门、分法庭、递酒。

abstract.en: Feel the bolt slide home: the room is closed.
abstract.cn: 体会门闩推到位：房间封死。

abstract.en: Bar is a line drawn across the world.
abstract.cn: bar 是在世界中划出的一道横线。

abstract.en: Picture soap, gold, music, and iron, all in bars.
abstract.cn: 想象肥皂、金条、乐谱小节与铁条，皆为 bar。

examples.en: A security guard bars the entrance at night.
She passed the exam and joined the bar.
examples.cn: 她通过考试，成为执业律师。

examples.en: The café has a long marble bar.
examples.cn: 这家咖啡馆有一条长长的大理石吧台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吧」——酒吧吧台是一根长「杆」，隔开你与酒保

root: 出自古法语 barre「杆、梁」，或溯至后期拉丁语 barra「杆条」（更早来源不确定）；英语兼取「杆条」本义与「法庭围栏」的法律义，并滋生禁止、闩住诸义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run along one rod: the strip itself, the bolt, the barrier, the court railing, the drink counter, and the verbs of barring, barring doors, and barring exceptions.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一根杆延展：条料、门闩、障碍、法庭围栏、酒柜，以及禁止、闩门与排除例外诸动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a rod laid across, stopping everything.
core.cn: 核心意象：横放的一根杆，拦住一切。

branches.en: Rod and bolt are the material beginnings.
branches.cn: 条料与门闩是物质起点。

branches.en: Laid across a road, the rod becomes an obstacle.
Railing names the court; counter names the tavern.
branches.cn: 围栏命名法庭，柜台命名酒馆。

branches.en: The verb shuts people out or doors in.
branches.cn: 动词把人拒外，把门封内。

branches.en: Barring exceptions completes the blocking story.
branches.cn: barring 例外补完阻挡叙事。

intro.en: The bar family keeps the Romance rod and multiplies across hardware, law, and trade words.
intro.cn: bar 词族保留罗曼语「杆」核，遍及五金、法律与贸易词。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin barra and its French barre are the bridge into English.
latinIntro.cn: 后期拉丁语 barra 与法语 barre 是进入英语的桥梁。
